scores.evidence: The loop-diagram flowchart TD fits at 390 px with readable Japanese labels and a caption (mobile-jp-04/05). The two-column loop-table and surfaces-table stay readable on mobile (mobile-jp-03, mobile-jp-07). The example-diff code wraps to short lines that fit 390 px without clipping (mobile-jp-14/15). No textOnlyScreens on either device.

Every screen has a heading, table, figure, code block or check (textOnlyScreens empty), and desktop charsPerLine median is 39, inside the 30–40 target. The practice section is long: 6 steps, then 2 prompt blocks, then a 6-item checklist, about 5 mobile screens in a row (mobile-jp-16 to mobile-jp-21). It is still split into clear chunks.

Japanese throughout, with English given only in parentheses on first use (エージェントループ（agentic loop）, mobile-jp-04). Diagram labels are Japanese, and the diagram has a caption and a 図の説明を読む disclosure (mobile-jp-05). Contrast is good on the callouts and code blocks, and no controls are hidden under the top or bottom bars.

niceToHave: example-steps: each step title starts with a circled digit (① 何をするプロジェクトか聞く), and the reader already draws a step number circle next to it, so it reads '1 ① …' (mobile-jp-12/13, desktop-jp-09). Keep the circled digits only if practice steps p-change/p-commit still need to point to them; otherwise drop them from the titles.

check-quiz q5 option a and q7 option b leave one or two characters alone on the second line at 1440 px ('確かめ / る', '入 / れる', desktop-jp-15/16). Shortening each by a few characters would keep it on one line.
reader: the 用語 sidebar lists both エージェントループ（agentic loop） and エージェントループ as separate chips (desktop-jp-01 and others). The definitions term and the glossary entry are not merged.

reader: known behaviour: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px (truncated: true); 14 failed /api/ requests were ignored; the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (mobile-jp-28, desktop-jp-20).
summary: lessonHash in metrics.json matches the expected sha256:9251fd0014082e5c. There are no hard failures (no horizontal overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors), every screen has a heading or element, and the diagram, tables and code blocks are readable and not cut off at 390 px. I found no personal data on any screenshot. The only issues are minor polish: the doubled step numbering in example-steps, and short leftover line ends in two exam options.
